result.summary: The 2022 page drops the 2021 story of pore-to-pipeline products, Schlumberger's 1920s well-logging origins, and the 'less-invasive' environmental-footprint commitment. It adds purpose, customer-centric and diversity language ('Our purpose', 'it is our diversity that makes us stronger'), cleaner and safer energy access for communities, and a Decarbonize/energy-transition push. Emphasis shifts toward customers, dei, community and environment.
